units.source_text: 我知道这句话是冲着我嘴角尚未消失的可爱的微笑而来的，

en.t: I knew that these words were directed at the lovely smile that had not yet faded from the corners of my mouth,

units.source_text: 然而我确实预想到他绝对体察不到我心中涌出的感谢的意味。

en.t: yet I was quite certain that he would never perceive the meaning of the gratitude welling up within me.

units.source_text: 这种确实的预想，使我更加自然地舒展我的微笑。

en.t: This certainty made my smile spread even more naturally.

units.source_text: 在人世间通常的友情的平面上，我提出这样的问题：

en.t: On the ordinary plane of friendship in this world, I put forward this question:
